auth.pitch.title: Know where your money is.
auth.pitch.body: Record income, expenses and transfers across your wallets. The same figures on your Mac and on your phone.
auth.pitch.foot: Rupiah, whole numbers, your time zone.
auth.unreachable: Couldn't reach Monetra. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with that email already exists.
auth.error.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.error.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password needs at least 8 characters.
auth.error.INVALID_TOKEN: This reset link is incomplete or has expired.
login.title: Sign in
login.sub: Use the email you registered with.
register.title: Create your account
register.sub: You start with a cash wallet and the usual categories.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sub: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.sub: You'll be signed out everywhere else.
reset.incomplete: This reset link is incomplete or has expired. <link>Ask for a new one</link>.
email.reset.subject: Reset your Monetra password
download.title: Monetra for Android
download.intro: Record income, expenses and transfers on your phone, even without signal. Everything syncs with the web when you're back online.
download.none: No Android build is published yet. Check back soon.
download.step1: Open this page on your Android phone and tap Download.
download.step2: Open the downloaded file. Android asks to allow installs from your browser the first time: allow it for this install.
download.step3: Tap Install, then sign in with your Monetra account. The first sign-in needs a connection.
download.updating: Updating: the app tells you when a new version is out, downloads it and opens the installer. Your data stays.
download.offline: Works offline. Balances and the dashboard are worked out on the phone.
download.sameAccount: Same account as the web. Your session is kept in Android's secure storage.
download.androidVersion: Android 6 or newer. iPhone isn't supported yet; use the web app in Safari meanwhile.
download.useWeb: Use Monetra on the web instead
settings.title: Settings
settings.demoNote: A demo account and everything in it is deleted after 24 hours.
settings.categoriesSub: Where income comes from and spending goes
settings.languageSub: Used on the web and on your phone. Wallet and category names stay as you wrote them.
settings.languageFailed: Couldn't change the language. Try again.
period.label: Period
dash.totalBalanceSub: Current position. The period doesn't change it.
tx.filtersUnreadable: Couldn't read those filters. Check the dates and try again.
filters.label: Find transactions
form.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above Rp 0, in whole rupiah.
form.typeHintTransfer: A transfer can't become income or expense: delete it and record the right type instead.
form.typeHintOther: An expense can become income, and you pick the category again. It can't become a transfer: delete it and record a transfer instead.
form.transferNote: A transfer moves money between your own wallets. It never counts as income or expense. If you paid an admin fee, record it as a separate expense in Biaya Admin.
form.finishCategory: Choose an {type} category to finish the change.
form.timeHint: It can't be in the future. Times are in {timezone}.
after.title: After you save
del.title: Delete this transaction?
del.body: It disappears from every list, balance and report. This can't be undone.
edit.title: Edit transaction
sheet.description: Record income, an expense or a transfer.
noWallet: No active wallet. Create or unarchive a wallet first.
wallets.belowZero: <red>Below zero.</red> A transfer in may be missing.
wallets.archivedNote: Hidden from new transactions, kept in history. Unarchive to edit.
wallets.openingHint: What the wallet held before its first recorded transaction. Start with a minus if you owed money, e.g. −250.000. You can change it later and the balance follows.
wallets.deleteNote: A wallet with no transactions can be deleted. Once it has transactions it can only be archived.
categories.archivedNote: Hidden from new transactions, kept in history and filters.
categories.deleteNote: A category no transaction uses can be deleted. Once a transaction uses it, it can only be archived.
error.type.transferToOther: A transfer can't become income or expense. Delete it and record the right type instead.
error.type.otherToTransfer: An income or expense can't become a transfer. Delete it and record a transfer instead.
error.amount.positive: Enter a whole rupiah amount above 0.
error.amount.example: Enter a whole rupiah amount, for example 18.000.
error.amount.noFraction: Enter a whole rupiah amount, with no fractions.
error.wallet.archived: That wallet is archived. Unarchive it or choose another one.
error.wallet.openingWhole: The opening balance is a whole rupiah amount.
error.wallet.notEmpty.holds: {name} still holds {amount}. A wallet can be archived only when its balance is exactly Rp 0.
error.wallet.notEmpty.below: {name} is at {amount}. A wallet can be archived only when its balance is exactly Rp 0.
error.wallet.inUse: This wallet has transactions, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead.
error.wallet.archivedEdit: {name} is archived. Unarchive it to make changes.
error.transfer.chooseTo: Choose the wallet the money goes to.
error.transfer.onlyTransferHasTo: Only a transfer has a destination wallet.
error.category.archived: That category is archived. Choose another one.
error.category.takenIncome: You already have an income category called {name}.
error.category.takenExpense: You already have an expense category called {name}.
error.category.takenArchivedIncome: An archived income category is already called {name}. Unarchive it instead.
error.category.takenArchivedExpense: An archived expense category is already called {name}. Unarchive it instead.
error.category.lastActiveIncome: This is your only active income category. Add or unarchive another one first.
error.category.lastActiveExpense: This is your only active expense category. Add or unarchive another one first.
error.category.inUse: This category has been used in transactions, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead.
error.occurredAt.future: The time can't be in the future.
error.description.tooLong: Keep the description to {max} characters or fewer.
error.name.tooLong: Keep the name to {max} characters or fewer.
error.idTaken: That ID belongs to another record.
error.invalidJson: The request body must be JSON.
error.demoExpired: This demo has ended. Start a new one from the sign-in page.
error.network: The connection dropped. What you typed is still here, and saving again won't create a duplicate.
error.period.reversed: The end date can't be before the start date.
m.auth.unreachable: Couldn't reach Monetra. Signing in needs a connection the first time.
m.auth.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in to sync what you recorded.
m.needsConnection: This needs a connection. Try again when online.
m.sync.signInAgain: Sign in again to sync. Everything you record stays on this phone meanwhile.

m.sync.offlinePending.other: You're offline. {count} changes wait on this phone and will sync when you're back online.
m.sync.offline: You're offline. You can keep recording; it syncs when you're back online.
m.sync.failed.one: Couldn't sync {count} change. It will try again.
m.sync.failed.other: Couldn't sync {count} changes. It will try again.
m.sync.refused.one: The server refused {count} change. Fix the record on this phone and it will sync again.
m.sync.refused.other: The server refused {count} changes. Fix the record on this phone and it will sync again.
m.settings.timezoneSub: Days, weeks and months start by this clock
m.signOut.title: Some changes aren't synced
m.signOut.body: Signing out now removes them from this phone, and they never reach your other devices. Sync first when you're online.
m.update.title: Monetra {version} is available
m.update.body: You have {current}. It downloads here, then Android asks you to install it over this one. Your data stays.
m.update.failed: Couldn't check for updates. Try again when online.
m.update.stopped: The download stopped. Check your connection and try again.
m.update.useBrowser: You can download it in your browser instead and open the file.
m.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Tap + to record your first transaction.
m.wallets.archivedNote: Kept in history and reports; not offered for new transactions
m.wallets.openingHelp: May be negative, for example a credit card.
m.del.body: It disappears from every list and from the balances, on all your devices. This can't be undone.
m.form.swap: Income and expense can swap; a transfer can't.
